n=λ+1>0 and |I|=n. For every integer t≥0, h y^t v=(λ−2t)y^t v; for t≥1, x y^t v=t(λ−t+1)y^(t−1)v. argument.text: By H001, every integer prime to p has nonzero image in K and therefore an inverse. The formula defining kappa:R→K is independent of fractional representatives by cross multiplication, preserves addition and multiplication, and extends the integer map. The balanced tensor maps V_K=M⊗_ℤ K→M_R⊗_R K and back are m⊗c↦(1⊗m)⊗c and (s⊗m)⊗c↦m⊗kappa(s)c. The tensor relations show that both are well-defined; the two composites fix pure tensors, hence are identity maps. Thus they are inverse K-linear isomorphisms. Since the maps act only on scalar factors, they intertwine every operator preserving M, including x,y,h,X_r,Y_r by N002.

argument.text: The reduction homomorphism R→F_p sends an integer fraction to numerator times inverse denominator. It is surjective because integers already map onto F_p. Its kernel is pR: a reduced fraction maps to zero exactly when its numerator is divisible by p, and division of that numerator by p stays in R. Consequently R/pR≅F_p and M_R/pM_R is an F_p-module. The maps M_R⊗_R K→(M_R/pM_R)⊗_(F_p)K and back send u⊗c to [u]⊗c and [u]⊗c to u⊗c. Changing u by a multiple of p changes u⊗c by zero, since p=0 in K. These formulas are balanced for the quotient R-action, are independent of representatives, and are inverse on pure tensors. They give the second K-linear isomorphism and commute with all induced lattice operators. Combine with F001 to obtain both tensor identifications asserted in the output.

produces.statement: V_K≅M_R⊗_R K≅(M_R/pM_R)⊗_(F_p)K by the stated natural operator-intertwining tensor maps.

argument.text: Choose b≠0 in J with J=Rb using N004. The family (b e_i)_{i∈I} is an R-basis of M_R by N004, using iota from N002. Define beta_i to be its reduced image in V_K through F001. Scalar extension of its coordinate maps gives a K-basis: every pure tensor has its finite coordinate expansion in beta_i, and the extended coordinate maps take beta_i to the corresponding coordinate unit vectors, proving independence. Therefore dim_K V_K=|I|=n=λ+1>0 by N001 and H002. Applying N001 to b e_i and using the tensor isomorphisms gives x beta_0=0, x beta_i=(λ−i+1)beta_(i−1) for 1≤i≤λ; y beta_i=(i+1)beta_(i+1) for i<λ, y beta_λ=0; h beta_i=(λ−2i)beta_i. All coefficients are the integer images in K. This proves the required basis and its generator matrices.
